text.tspan: Pass 5 checks (1, 2) in order; 0 swaps made -> Early Exit!
Sorted suffix grows leftward each pass: O(n) best, O(n^2) worst.

text.tspan: Left: microscopic adjacent comparisons in Pass 1. Right: macroscopic passes to sorted completion.
